purpose: Extend the qualified nonintegrability evidence to the planar zero-angular-momentum common levels with nonzero energy.
goal: Reproduce the exact Pacella/Combot Euler-Moulton spectral obstruction and bind it to the pinned 2025 theorem on restricted rational integrability of M_(h,0), h nonzero.
evidence_boundary: A PASS qualifies failure of restricted rational complete integrability for the planar positive-mass three-body problem on every common level (H,C)=(h,0) with h nonzero. It does not cover (0,0), the spatial problem, non-rational regularity classes, absence of one additional integral, or a collision-regularized extension.

model.phase_space: planar algebraic-distance extension after center-of-mass reduction
model.integrability: restricted rational integrability as defined by Maciejewski--Przybylska--Combot 2025
model.spectral_input: Pacella longitudinal eigenvalue lambda>2 and transverse eigenvalue -lambda/2

theorem_obligations.R1: Pin and machine-check the 2025 common-level theorem, its definition of restricted integrability, and its explicit c=0,h!=0 branch.
theorem_obligations.R2: Pin and machine-check the Combot reproduction of Pacella's spectrum {0,2,lambda_i} with lambda_i>2.
theorem_obligations.R3: Prove exactly that the transverse eigenvalue -lambda_i/2 is strictly below -1.
theorem_obligations.R4: Reproduce the degree-minus-one Morales-Ramis allowed spectrum {((k-1)(k+2))/2:k in N_0} and prove every member is at least -1.
theorem_obligations.R5: Conclude the transverse scalar NVE has differential Galois group SL(2,C), hence non-solvable identity component.
theorem_obligations.R6: Apply the weaker solvability necessary condition for restricted integrability on M_(h,0), not the stronger Abelian condition by substitution.
theorem_obligations.R7: Independently reproduce the exact equal-mass three-body Euler benchmark lambda=24/5 and transverse eigenvalue -12/5.
theorem_obligations.R8: Keep the collinear witness separate from the non-collinear WP2-SO3-LEAF-v1 chart.
theorem_obligations.R9: Record why the homothetic first variational equation supplies no obstruction on (H,C)=(0,0).
theorem_obligations.R10: Reject any conclusion about one additional integral, spatial zero momentum, non-rational integrals, or global collision regularity.

independent_validation.production: Exact Fraction spectral and common-level decision certificates.
independent_validation.reference: A source-disjoint exact matrix construction for the equal-mass Euler central configuration and independent generation of the allowed spectrum.

adversarial_controls: Reject h=0 as qualified by this track.
Reject nonzero angular momentum as a zero-L case.
Reject lambda<=2 as satisfying the Pacella premise.
Detect a changed transverse factor or allowed-spectrum formula.
Detect replacement of solvability by an unproved fixed-leaf Abelian condition.
Reject a reference implementation that imports production.

decision_policy.PASS: Every source, spectral, exact benchmark, common-level implication, adversarial, proof-coverage, and boundary gate passes under a frozen implementation.
decision_policy.AUTHORIZED_CLAIM: For arbitrary finite positive masses and every finite nonzero energy h, the planar Newtonian three-body problem restricted to the common level (H,C)=(h,0) is not rationally integrable in the locked restricted-integrability sense.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_DOUBLE_ZERO_CLAIM: The same witness proves nonintegrability on (H,C)=(0,0).
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_ONE_INTEGRAL_CLAIM: No one additional integral exists on the zero-angular-momentum level.
decision_policy.PROHIBITED_SPATIAL_CLAIM: The spatial zero-angular-momentum problem is qualified by this track.

invalidation: Any changed common-level definition, source, spectral premise, energy domain, obligation, decision rule, or frozen implementation invalidates v1.
